canada.title: This Nunavut student wants to be a nurse. Her community doesn’t offer the right courses

canada.title: Divers find long-lost WW II shipwreck headed for Saint John
canada.summary: The SS Cornwallis was on its way to Saint John when it was struck by a German torpedo in 1944 and hadn't been seen since. In July, a group of divers rounded off their seven-year-long expedition when they finally found her in the Gulf of Maine.

bds.h: Polish authorities blame Krakow attack on ‘far-right ideologies’
bds.lede: Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said the suspect in the mass shooting holds “very radical” and “ultranationalistic” views.
rows: The attack, which Poland's defense minister described as an "act of terror," happened in Main Square, a major tourist hub in the heart of Krakow's Old Town.
Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.
Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said the suspect in the mass shooting holds “very radical” and “ultranationalistic” views.

Poland began two days of national mourning on Sunday, after a 24-year-old man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow and opened fire, killing six people and wounding 15 others before police shot and wounded him.
The Canadian Press (via Winnipeg Free Press)
KRAKOW, Poland (AP) — Tourists and locals alike this weekend witnessed a mass shooting in Krakow, Poland, that left six people dead and 15 wounded.
